Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649957 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649957. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno to get chembl_id. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN required). Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
